title: High-energy asymptotics for finite-interval Schrödinger operators with Gaussian white-noise potential
summary: We study the one-dimensional Schrödinger operator on a fixed interval with Gaussian white-noise potential, \[ H_ω=-\frac{\dd^2}{\dd x^2}+ρ\dot B_x(ω), \] under Dirichlet boundary conditions. The operator is defined pathwise through the quasi-derivative realization of Sturm--Liouville operators with distributional potentials. Let $λ_n$ be the Dirichlet eigenvalues, $λ_n^+=\max\{λ_n,0\}$, and $k_n=\sqrt{λ_n^+}$.
